claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Bits 1..t define R(W)=W^t+sum_{v<t} x_{v+1}W^v and bits t+1..t+m define Q(Z)=Z^m+sum_{u<m} x_{t+u+1}Z^u over F_2; if R or Q fails the exact irreducibility test of proof.md (X^(2^d)=X mod P, and gcd(P,X^(2^d')-X)=1 for every divisor d' of d=deg P with d'<d) output 0. Consequently liminf over all integers N of C_B2(L_N)/N >= 22919841701871939/4905443192389955. experiments.purpose: Proposition C of cutwidth.md: sup over all real t of G_d(t) <= 4905443192389955/36028797018963968, the only computer-assisted step of the proof. The program is pure Python (standard library only) with its own outward-rounded interval arithmetic; its method and error analysis are in certificate.md (Theorem PL, Lemmas 5.9-5.12, section 6). It covers the whole real line (analytic tails plus a contiguous cover of [-5/4, 2] by leaves), bounds G_d on every leaf, compares every leaf bound with 4905443192389955/36028797018963968 exactly, and prints one JSON object with certified, the cover, the counts and the largest certified bound. It also re-checks by exhaustive enumeration the finite facts C1, C2, C6 and the rational witnesses C4 of cutwidth.md, which are proved in the text as well. It takes no parameters.
